'''Avanj''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] apprentice of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ranor]]. They betrayed the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and were [[Death/Legends|killed]] along with him on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
